response.sql: WITH account_totals AS (SELECT t.account_id, d.A3 AS region, SUM(t.amount) AS total_transaction_amount, COUNT(*) AS transaction_count FROM trans AS t JOIN account AS a ON a.account_id = t.account_id JOIN district AS d ON d.district_id = a.district_id GROUP BY t.account_id, d.A3) SELECT account_id, region, total_transaction_amount, transaction_count, CAST(total_transaction_amount AS REAL) / NULLIF(SUM(total_transaction_amount) OVER (), 0) AS fraction_of_all_transaction_amounts FROM account_totals ORDER BY fraction_of_all_transaction_amounts DESC, account_id LIMIT 10;
